name: Crushing Pressure, Mass Greater
body:
School transmutation; Level psychic 9, sorcerer/wizard 9, witch 9

EFFECT

Target one creature/level, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart
Duration 5 rounds + 1 round/level (max 25)

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as greater crushing pressure except it affects multiple targets.
